rows.approval: ABC licence, Type 48 (on-sale general, public premises)
rows.agency: California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control

basis.text: The licence looked up is ABC Type 48 (on-sale general, public premises), as stated in the description.

A Type 48 licence is an on-sale general licence. State law limits these to one for each 2,000 inhabitants of the county; in a county over that number ABC issues no additional one, so the licence comes by transfer of an existing licence unless state law allows otherwise.
Census tract 106.00: 52 active on-sale retail licences in ABC's licences as they stood on 16 March 2022, against 12 authorised in ABC's census tract authorisations of September 2026.

The tract is over its authorised number. State law tests a new licence and a transfer from other premises for undue concentration, and the applicant does not say how the liquor licence will be obtained.

The description does not give how the liquor licence will be obtained (new, or a transfer from another owner or another location), so the rules cannot say which licence rules apply: insufficient information.

Licences with an unknown status on 2022-03-16: 19 ABC licences within 1,000 ft and 15 in the census tract were on file, but ABC's daily reports do not show their status that day (it changed two or more times since). They are left out of the licence counts, the census tract count and what the space is read as.
